# Laurent Debacker

> Personal website and resume of Laurent Debacker, a Full Stack Developer based in Duncan, BC, Canada. Belgian-born, in Canada since 2006, Canadian since 2015. Speaks French, English, Dutch, German and West Flemish. The site also hosts Ten Things, a multiplayer trivia game, plus a handful of browser quizzes.

The site is a single-page React application, so page content is rendered client-side. The list of indexable pages is also available at https://belgocanadian.com/sitemap.xml.

## Resume

- [Home](https://belgocanadian.com/home): Short introduction, location, languages and social links
- [Experience](https://belgocanadian.com/experience): Work history
- [Skills](https://belgocanadian.com/skills): Technical skills
- [Hobbies](https://belgocanadian.com/hobbies): Interests outside of work
- [Contact](https://belgocanadian.com/contact): Contact form

## Ten Things

- [Ten Things](https://belgocanadian.com/tenthings): A multiplayer trivia game where players guess the ten items on a list. Playable as a Telegram bot, a Discord bot and on the web

## Quizzes

- [Google](https://belgocanadian.com/google): Name the place
- [Logos](https://belgocanadian.com/logos): Identify the brands
- [Movies](https://belgocanadian.com/movies): Name that film
- [Flags](https://belgocanadian.com/flags): Match the country
- [Animals](https://belgocanadian.com/animals): Identify the animal by its call
- [Skeletons](https://belgocanadian.com/skeletons): Anatomy quiz
